title: LEONA – festival live sessions
description: To support LEONA's festival applications and promotional campaign, I produced a series of cinematic live session videos that captured the atmosphere and emotion of her music. Filmed at the Deutsches Haus in Flensburg, the goal was to create an intimate performance setting that felt authentic while delivering high-end visual quality for festivals, promoters, and booking agencies.

The production was filmed using a multicam setup with the Sony FX3 and Sony A7 IV. Audio was recorded separately, professionally mixed and mastered, and then synchronized with the footage in post-production. I was responsible for the complete video production workflow – from camera setup and filming to editing, color grading, and the final delivery of the live session videos.

title: norder147 x canim3denim
description: This non-profit project documented an upcycling workshop hosted at NORDER147, a creative project space and atelier in Flensburg. The goal was to capture the workshop's atmosphere while highlighting how simple and accessible it can be to transform old clothing into something new, encouraging a more sustainable approach to fashion.

The event was filmed in collaboration with my friend Larissa, while I was responsible for the editing and post-production. As the workshop was organized by a friend (canim3denim), we volunteered our work to support the project and help increase its visibility through a short highlight movie that reflects the creative and community-driven spirit of the event and captures the moment.

title: Gården Festival 2026
description: As part of the media coverage for Gården Festival in Tydal, Eggebek, I produced photo and video content for multiple artists and performances throughout the festival. My main focus was creating dynamic festival content for Qrue Collective, while also filming live performances by MALM and Leona, alongside capturing photography and videography for the Danish artists AFSKUM and Søn.

Working in a fast-paced festival environment, I documented live performances, backstage moments, and the overall atmosphere of the event. The goal was to create authentic, cinematic content that reflected the energy of the festival and its artists.

title: QRUE Collective x Kühlhaus Flensburg
description: This project documents the QRUE PLUS event at Kühlhaus Flensburg, where I was responsible for filming the live performance in an indoor concert setting with a deliberately minimal equipment setup. The production environment came with initial technical challenges, particularly regarding audio capture and room acoustics.

Despite these constraints, I focused on maximizing the available resources to deliver the highest possible audiovisual quality. Through adaptive on-site decision-making and careful post-production work, the final result preserves the raw energy of the event while maintaining a clean and usable sound and image representation of the performance.

title: Flensburg Akademie
summary: Social-Media-Content, Foto & Grafikdesign als Working Student.
description: As a working student at Flensburg Akademie, I was responsible for Social Media Management while also working as a Photographer, Digital Creator, and Graphic Designer. Acting as a versatile all-rounder, I supported a wide range of creative and strategic tasks and contributed to building a strong, visually consistent digital presence.

title: Vertical Sessions
description: Platzhalter-Beschreibung: Hier kommt der Text zu einer Reihe von vertikalen Kurzform-Videos für Instagram Reels/TikTok – z. B. Behind-the-Scenes-Schnipsel, Song-Teaser oder Studio-Momente.
Ersetze diesen Absatz und die Medien in src/data/projects.json, sobald das echte Material vorliegt. Das Layout (Handy-Mockup, Swipe durch mehrere Clips) bleibt automatisch erhalten.

title: Farblook Test Reel

description: Platzhalter-Beschreibung: Ein Showcase für Color-Grading-Arbeit – Rohmaterial direkt aus der Kamera im Vergleich zum fertigen Look nach der Bearbeitung in DaVinci Resolve.
Trage in src/data/projects.json pro Vergleich ein Vorher- und ein Nachher-Bild (gleiches Motiv) ein. Auf der Projektseite lässt sich dann live zwischen beiden Zuständen gewischt/gezogen werden.

title: Studio Live Session
